blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — The Philippines and Chile officially signed a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on Thursday during the sidelines of the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting. The agreement, seen as a boost to the country’s trade deals in South America, was inked during a bilateral meeting between President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Chilean President José Antonio Kast.
